# Unleash the Darkness:

## INFO:
Map Forcer is needed to play this mod! Download here: [Mod Link](https://runeforge.dev/mods/d410324f-3b6d-4dde-9f2e-fad097454ae4)

Download and conquer the shadows in this chilling showcase of Summoner's Rift's dark side!

## About the Mod:

Embark on a haunting odyssey into the unknown as you explore the **Rift of the Unbound**, a chilling transformation of the classic battleground. Immerse yourself in the eerie depths of Summoner's Rift with this custom map skin, featuring a captivating recolor inspired by the unsettling mysteries that lurk beyond the Blackmoon.



## Changes:

* Full recolor of the Summoners Rift map to Blackmoon
* All Jungle Camps and Mobs are supported and fully recolored
* Custom Loadingscreen
* Default Map 
* Default Turrets & Minions
